CO:IRD:2026:27:112                                                                                    
Date: 17th July, 2026 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Sub: Audio recording of Conference/Earnings call held with the Analysts/ Institutional  
         Investors on 17th July, 2026. 
 
In reference to our letter no. CO:IRD:2026:27:103 dated 14th July, 2026, this is to inform that the 
audio recording of Conference/Earnings call held with the Analysts/Investors on 17th July, 2026 
on unaudited Financial Results of the Bank for the First quarter and Three months ended           
30th June, 2026 have been uploaded on our Bank’s website and can be accessed through 
following link: 
https://www.centralbank.bank.in/sites/default/files/10045033.mp3 or 
https://www.centralbank.bank.in/en/investor-relations   
 
Please take the above on your record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Central Bank of India                                                   
 
 
CHANDRAKANT BHAGWAT                                                                      
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
